column1: # Single source of truth for every macOS release this tool knows about.
# Fields are tab-separated, in this order:
#   codename         normalized slug used on the command line (lower case, no separators)
#   version          version number used by Apple's tools
#   year             release year, shown in the interactive menu
#   kind             how the installer is obtained:
#                      catalog-base      direct file fetch from Apple's software update CDN
#   url              download URL or base URL for the kind above, "-" when unused
#   recovery_board   macrecovery board id, "-" when the recovery path is unsupported
# Never leave a field empty: use "-". An empty field would collapse into the
# neighbouring one, because tab is IFS whitespace and runs get merged.
# Adding a new release means adding one row here. Update
# .github/workflows/build-macos-image.yml options as well; the drift check in
# tools/check-versions.sh fails the build when the two disagree.
# tahoe reuses Catalina's board id on purpose: macrecovery only needs it to sign
# the request, and this is the pair upstream shipped and validated.
